source: Own measurement (2026-11-27, job 62795571, folder rack-anchor3), ten-rod rack version of the task: the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh; controller RodOracle, bounded Cartesian servo, with the reference token, which gives it ground truth and assisted grasping) on the six fixed hidden shifts of tests/hidden/shifts.json, each through the grading path (solve.sh + verify.py + the kit's wire) in the task's final cell: ten hanging rods, one released per event at a place drawn with shift-hidden frequencies, feed on its own timetable, a cell that does not wait for the controller (reply time = the controller's CPU time), physical grasping for contestants, rubber finger pads (friction 2.0). Real simulator on the author's cluster (H200, Isaac Sim 6.1, PhysX on the CPU; rootless, so the kit's runuser step was bypassed in a temporary copy). Per shift, seed: score (placed/20): 4418: 1.00 (20), 7093: 1.00 (20), 1256: 0.75 (15), 8830: 1.00 (20), 3607: 1.00 (20), 5971: 1.00 (20); mean 0.9583. Probe lock passed on every shift (all probes), no bystander moved, no late step charged. Shift 1256 lost five rods in its last third; the cause is not known. ONE measurement so far; the simulator is not bit-reproducible between runs (single shifts of the earlier single-rod version moved by up to 0.175). The six seeds are the first six drawn; none was selected or replaced after measuring. full_at 0.90: the reference's own six-shift mean has to stay above 0.8625 to earn the full reward.
note: part_pickup_score = mean per-part credit (1.0 in the tote, 0.5 held for 1 s, 0 lost, -0.5 per disturbed bystander), mean over the hidden shifts.
